headline: An empty home in Spain
still files a tax return.
sub: Spain taxes the use of the home, not only the rent.

rows.label: The base
fact: The figure comes off your IBI receipt, not what you paid.
rows.detail: Cadastral value, not market value or purchase price.

rows.label: The maths
fact: Cadastral value x 1.1% or 2%, then 19% EU or 24% non-EU.

rows.label: The date
rows.detail: Rental income is filed annually now, not quarterly.
